# CineRename

> A local-first tool to rename and organize movies, TV shows, anime, and subtitles for Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, and Kodi-style libraries.

## About CineRename
CineRename is a desktop application that previews safe batch renames, cleans up duplicates, and organizes media libraries with metadata from configured providers such as TheTVDB, TVmaze, AniList, Kitsu, and OpenSubtitles. It produces folder structures designed for modern media servers.

## Key Features
- Drag & Drop Interface
- Automatic and Manual modes
- TheTVDB Integration
- Blazing fast performance (built with Tauri and Rust)
- Subtitle preview, download, offset and drift tools
- Dry-run reports
